description: This source file provides utility functions for cryptographic operations, specifically generating and decrypting organization IDs using AES encryption with a tenant-specific salt. It includes functions for converting hex to CryptoJS WordArray, generating organization IDs based on emails, decrypting organization IDs for debugging, and validating the tenant salt.

methods.name: hexToWordArray(hex)
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string into a CryptoJS WordArray for cryptographic operations.

methods.name: generateOrganizationId(email)
methods.description: Generates a URL-safe organization ID by encrypting a normalized email using a tenant-specific AES-128-ECB key, returning a base64-encoded string without padding, URL-encoded.

methods.name: decryptOrganizationId(encUrlEncoded)
methods.description: Decrypts the organization ID (for debugging purposes), reversing the encryption process to retrieve the original email.

methods.name: isTenantSaltValid()
methods.description: Checks if the tenant salt is present and non-empty, indicating validity.
